entities.name: PMID:25448003
observations: In Physcomitrella/Physcomitrium patens, two plasma-membrane-targeted PIN proteins in leafy gametophores regulate apical-cell function, leaf initiation and shape, and shoot tropisms; auxin perturbations and pin mutants produce corresponding developmental defects. Source: call_NI8WA21Ng6jT7jUgL54svrUY.

entities.name: PMID:37052186
observations: CNIH2 acts as a cargo receptor controlling PINA interaction, trafficking, and polar plasma-membrane localization; cornichon mutants alter auxin-dependent growth. Source: call_YSwgKJXowOjNWlFcPjnEgTQB.

entities.name: PMID:36696950
observations: PpPINC knockout primarily affects sperm motility, spermatogenesis, fertility, and premeiotic sporophyte retention; the abstract does not establish a vegetative gametophore-shoot defect. Source: call_1Ys5jm0c1yJJjbQGcJxbdDyh.

entities.name: PpPINA
observations: A plasma-membrane-targeted PIN auxin transporter expressed in leafy moss shoots; its localization and transport function are implicated in shoot development. Sources: call_NI8WA21Ng6jT7jUgL54svrUY; call_YSwgKJXowOjNWlFcPjnEgTQB.

entities.name: PpPINB
observations: A second plasma-membrane-targeted PIN protein expressed in leafy moss shoots; PIN-mediated auxin transport contributes to shoot and leaf development. Source: call_NI8WA21Ng6jT7jUgL54svrUY.

entities.name: PpPINC
observations: PpPINC is a canonical moss PIN, but available primary evidence emphasizes reproductive and sporophyte-retention functions rather than vegetative gametophore shoot morphogenesis. Source: call_1Ys5jm0c1yJJjbQGcJxbdDyh.

entities.name: Moss shoot development
observations: PIN loss or reduced auxin transport causes defects in apical function, leaf initiation and shape, tropisms, and branching in Physcomitrium patens. Source: call_NI8WA21Ng6jT7jUgL54svrUY.

entities.name: PINA membrane trafficking
observations: CNIH2-dependent trafficking controls PINA polar membrane localization and is linked to auxin-dependent growth in Physcomitrium patens. Source: call_YSwgKJXowOjNWlFcPjnEgTQB.
